title: Stage 2 of the autopilot test plan is safe to run when a guard fails: its attempts name harmless targets
goal: kb/_self/autopilot-test.md Stage 2 gives each attempt a target that does no harm if the guard does not refuse it (a remote name that does not exist for sync --push --remote, a merge of an item with no open merge request, a throwaway item and gate for the answer attempts) and says to export the runner's variables in the shell before the commands; found by the first supervised run (ST-opjydjc3): run as written, sync --push --branch scratch and merge BG-xxxxxxxx would push a branch to, or merge a request of, the real integration remote when a guard failed, and the variables as a command prefix did not work in zsh
